origin: Lâm Kim Bách / Bách Lâm / Optimizer

core_model.claim: The retained object is modeled as a generative compressed seed rather than a complete transcript.

retention_heuristic: RetentionPriority(x) ~= CausalCentrality * CrossTrajectoryRecurrence * DecisionSensitivity * ReconstructionPower * SurvivalValue

reading_model.chain: Read -> Trigger -> Reconstruct -> Recombine -> Test -> Retain

bl_infinity_relation: A viable seed must preserve ontology openness because a closed rule set can become a cognitive prison even after massive experience.
unknown_relation: UNKNOWN is treated as the reopenable frontier that cannot be compressed into final answers without risking ontology closure.
grand_ending_relation: Repeated trajectories can be compressed into attractor signatures such as optionality collapse, cooperation breakdown, ontology closure, correlated blindness and novelty exhaustion.
cooperation_relation: Distributed cognition can extend beyond the capacity of one carrier while preserving independent blind spots and structured disagreement.
